name: Banana Peel
phrases: If you deployed this card during an opponent's turn
notes: Extra cost condition isActivePlayer player:controller negated; in a block this means 'a turn of some opponent'. It is not a reference to a bound opponent.
ruling: 'An opponent's turn' = any turn whose active player is not the controller; no opponent binding is needed or consumed.

name: Big McLargehuge
phrases: pick an opponent and that player destroys a face-down resource they control
notes: One bound opponent at the leaves-play trigger.

name: Bottlebeard Brandyshanks
phrases: The top card of each opponent's deck is revealed at all times
If any of those cards are a character, this card gains 3 speed
Pick an opponent
notes: Reveal static (grantsReveal of:opponent) covers every opponent (ok). The speed static tests deckPosition player:opponent (one deck); it must be existential over all opponents' top cards ('any of those cards'). CHUG! binds one opponent (ok).

name: Breath of the Barduse
phrases: Each player destroys 2 character they own
notes: Already forEachPlayer (activeFirst). Verify chooser 'controller' and owner:self rebind to the iterated player inside the fan-out.

name: Camouflaged Urchin
phrases: your opponents cannot pick this card
notes: cannotBePickedByOpponents static = every opponent.

name: Candy Skull Commander
phrases: Whenever an opponent forms an attacking party
notes: Trigger is battleStarted with battleRole defender, i.e. only when this card's controller is attacked. Text fires whenever any opponent forms an attacking party, including one aimed at a third player; needs the trigger keyed on attacker controlled by an opponent regardless of defender.

name: Carnival Funhouse
phrases: pick one character your opponent controls and one character you control
notes: One bound opponent for the onPlay block; modifiers are created on the picked cards.

name: Carnival Whipmaster
phrases: Take control of one character and one item an opponent controls
notes: Single bound opponent supplies both the character and the item (same reading as 2-player).

name: Clockman City Shuffle
phrases: characters your opponents control lose 1 strength and 1 life
notes: forEach selector controller:opponent inside a resolving block would resolve to the bound opponent only; must hit every opponent's characters (wrap in forEachPlayer over opponents or use an all-opponents selector scope). Own-character boost unchanged.

name: Confrontational Conflagration
phrases: Pick a character an opponent controls
notes: One bound opponent's character; other targets are not player-relative.

name: Conniving Puppeteer
phrases: an opponent's discard pile
notes: Cost-time pick from one bound opponent's discard pile.

name: Contiguous Defalcating Machine
phrases: its controller
Put a resource they control into its owners's hand
Their faction loses 3 influence
notes: The affected player is the entering character's controller, who can be any seat (not the machine's controller or its bound opponent). Option 1 selects the resource with selector controller:self / controller:opponent behind an eventCardControlledBy branch; in 3+ players this must be a selector bound to controllerOf(eventCard) (drop the self/opponent branching). Options 2 and 3 already use eventCard / controllerOf and are fine.

name: Corrosive Waste Dispenser
phrases: Each opponent destroys a character they control
notes: Wrap the chooser/selector opponent effect in forEachPlayer over every opponent.

name: Cunning Ruse
phrases: Flip the item face-down under its opponent's control
notes: Encoded as a plain face-down flip in place with no control change; 'its opponent's control' names no bound opponent and would be undefined with 3+ players.
ruling: Keep the classic encoding: the item is flipped face-down under its current controller (the printed 'its opponent' is read as the existing opposing controller / owner, no control change), so no opponent is consumed.

name: Dual Blade Assassin
phrases: if you inflicted damage to an opponent's faction this turn
notes: Deploy condition playerInflictedDamageToFactionThisTurn player:opponent must be existential over all opponents (any opponent's faction), not just a bound one, since it gates legality before any binding.

name: Engorged Sarcophyle
phrases: pick an opponent
That opponent destroys a character they control
notes: One bound opponent chosen via the faction target; owner/controller of the character resolve to it.

name: Enlightened Sarcophyle
phrases: each opponent loses 1 influence
notes: Wrap modifyInfluence player:opponent in forEachPlayer over every opponent. The controller +1 stays outside.

name: Escort Ally
phrases: cannot be destroyed by cards or abilities your opponents control
notes: installReplacement with by:opponent creates a lingering effect. Text says all opponents, so it must not capture the single bound opponent (D4 created-effect binding); it must apply to every opponent's cards/abilities.

name: Expedition Endeavour
phrases: An opponent may detach up to 3 resources
notes: Option 1 extra cost: one bound opponent (bound at play, before cost payment) may detach; matches 'an opponent'. Other options reference no player.

name: Extremely Tiny Bonnet of Invisibility
phrases: Pick an opponent
That player may detach up to 2 resources from their faction
notes: One bound opponent for the onPlay block.

name: Finger Explosive
phrases: a character an opponent controls
notes: One bound opponent's character.

name: Flaming Cube
phrases: each opponents' faction loses 6 influence
Any player may use this ability
notes: fc-boom modifyInfluence player:opponent must be wrapped in forEachPlayer over every opponent. CONTROL THE FLAME (usableBy anyPlayer, selector controller:self) is correct for any seat provided 'self'/'controller' = the activating player.

name: Flesh Deliquesce
phrases: Pick an opponent
the number of detached resources that player controls
notes: X counts the bound opponent's detached resources; binding must occur before the variable is evaluated.

name: Foreclosure Overseer
phrases: your opponents must pay 1 to deploy cards
notes: Static costModifiers affects:opponent = every opponent.

name: Forgotten Tentacle
phrases: Pick an opponent
that player
notes: Resolving block with one 'Pick an opponent'; all later 'that player' refs (selector opponent, chooser opponent, draw/playResource player opponent) resolve to the bound opponent.

name: Frantic Jerryrigging
phrases: destroy an item your opponent controls
notes: One bound opponent in the resolving block.

name: Geldale, City-Fortress
phrases: You opponents may only play tactics during their own turn
notes: Static playRestrictions player:opponent timing notActivePlayer = every opponent restricted to their own turn.

name: Gigantitect's Giant Giant
phrases: Opponents cannot take control of this card.
notes: Static restriction cannotBeTakenControl applies against every opponent. Confirm the restriction only blocks control changes to other players, not controller-initiated effects, since in Showdown a Hero can be an 'opponent' of another Hero.

name: God's Blessing of Readiness
phrases: At the start of each opponent's turn
notes: Granted trigger fires on turnStarted when the event player is not the controller = every opponent's turn (static trigger, matches 'each opponent's turn').

name: Gor-blach the Endowed
phrases: Inflict X damage to an opponent's faction
notes: One bound opponent's faction in the resolving block. (The blocker's controller could be a different opponent; printed text says 'an opponent', so bound reading is fine.)

name: Hassan-i of Thabbash
phrases: each opponent must destroy a character they control
notes: Death trigger encodes a single chooserSelectsTarget with chooser/selector opponent; wrap in forEachPlayer over every opponent (each destroys one of their own).

name: Illusionist's Trick
phrases: Pick an opponent
That opponent puts cards equal to the highest speed
notes: One bound opponent via the faction target; mill targets ownerOf it.

name: Insidious Brainworm
phrases: each opponent loses 3 influence
notes: Wrap modifyInfluence player:opponent in forEachPlayer over every opponent.

name: Juice Sale!
phrases: Pick an opponent's character with the highest strength
notes: One bound opponent; the isExtremum 'among' set is also controller:opponent = that opponent's characters. Reading is highest among the bound opponent's characters; same as 2-player.

name: Lockbox of the Aeons
phrases: Your opponents cannot use FLIP UP
cards cannot be put into your opponents' hands
notes: Static playRestrictions / restrictReturnToHand player:opponent apply to every opponent (D4 static).

name: Lost on Floor 3
phrases: your opponent paying a cost at the end of your turn
notes: Parenthetical reminder only; the encoding is condition endOfTurnDeclared(controller) with no opponent reference. Any other player can be the one who responded.

name: Luteorunic Behemoth
phrases: all opponents must destroy 4 non-staple cards they control
notes: Wrap the chooser/selector opponent effect in forEachPlayer over every opponent (each destroys 4 of their own non-staple cards).

name: Man Shark
phrases: each face-down resource each opponent controls
Pick an opponent
notes: Static strength/life count over controller:opponent face-down resources = all opponents (D4 static, matches 'each opponent'). FOLLOW SUIT binds one opponent.

name: Martial Arts Wannabe
phrases: While you control more characters than any opponent
notes: Static compares own count to count of controller:opponent characters, which sums all opponents. 'More than any opponent' = more than every individual opponent (greater than the max per-opponent count); needs a per-opponent quantified (all opponents) comparison.

name: Master General
phrases: When a player deploys a tactic, inflict 3 damage to that player's faction
notes: mg-opp fires for any opponent playing a tactic, but its damage targets factionOf player:opponent (a bound opponent, not necessarily the player who deployed). Target must be the event player's faction; the two abilities can merge using an eventPlayer ref.

name: Micromajigmakermachinemajig
phrases: Pick an opponent
That player may put a Micromajig token into play under their control
notes: One bound opponent; the token creation is an otherPlayerChooses cost for the bound opponent. Damage-reduction effect is attached to the token it creates.

name: Mindrender
phrases: When an opponent discards a card
notes: Static trigger eventPlayerIs opponent = any opponent.

name: Moment of Annihilation
phrases: an opponent's discard pile
notes: Extra-cost selection from one bound opponent's discard pile (bound before cost).

name: Negotiation Ceremonies
phrases: Pick an opponent
that opponent may pay 1
Each player draws cards equal to the amount they paid
notes: alternatingPay between controller and one bound opponent (first/opponent tuple, vars __paidByFirst/__paidByOpponent); 'each player' = controller + bound opponent per MP 3. Needs the alternatingPay generalisation (tuple -> arrays/records) bound to controller + bound opponent; no fan-out to other seats.

name: Neuralyzer Agent
phrases: pick an opponent
an opponent's faction
that faction's owner discards a card
notes: Attack trigger is fine (bound opponent). The second ability (battle damage to 'an opponent's faction') fires for any opponent's faction but its discard uses chooser/selector 'opponent', which would bind an arbitrary opponent; discard must target ownerOf/controllerOf(eventCard) (the damaged faction's owner).

name: Omahkapi'si Pi'kssii
phrases: While there are at least 10 cards in an opponent's discard pile, that player cannot pick this card
Pick a card in an opponent's discard pile
notes: Static counts the summed discard piles of all opponents and then bars all opponents (cannotBePickedByOpponents). Should be per opponent: only an opponent whose own discard pile has >= 10 cards is barred. FLEX binds one opponent (ok).

name: Opportunistic Pirate
phrases: an opponent's discard pile
notes: Extra-cost selection from one bound opponent's discard pile (bound before cost). No other player references.

name: Purloining Performance
phrases: Pick an opponent
that player's deck
notes: One bound opponent; look/mill use player:opponent.

name: Quotidian Transposition
phrases: Each player picks a character they own
notes: Already wrapped in forEachPlayer. Verify that inside forEachPlayer the chooser 'controller' and selector owner:self rebind to the iterated player (each player picks their own).

name: Rantzigite Inquisitor
phrases: pick an opponent
That opponent discards a card
notes: One bound opponent chosen at the destroy trigger.

name: Rasputin Unleashed
phrases: pick an opponent
the speed of all characters that opponent controls is reduced to 0
notes: createAreaModifier with selector controller:opponent creates a lingering effect that must stay bound to the opponent chosen when the trigger resolved (D4 created-effect binding); otherwise it would re-resolve against all/other opponents each evaluation. Store opponentId on the area modifier.

name: Recycling Scheme Facility
phrases: any player may pay 4
notes: anyPlayerMayPay must offer the payment to every living seat in order (not just controller/opponent); first payer moves the character to the top of its owner's deck. Other ability needs no change.

name: Rocket Lawnchair
phrases: Pick a character an opponent controls
an opponent's attacking party
notes: 'theirs' is the bound opponent's character, but the 'opponent's attacking party' check uses isActivePlayer player:opponent, which would only match the bound opponent.
ruling: Treat 'an opponent's attacking party' as any attacking party whose controller is not the Lawnchair's controller (active player != controller), independent of the bound opponent; the picked opponent character is the bound opponent's.

name: Runic Junker
phrases: pick an opponent
That player must pick a face-down resource you control
notes: One bound opponent chosen in the trigger block; chooser opponent matches.

name: Seance Ritualist
phrases: Pick an opponent
That player discards X cards
notes: One bound opponent; cost X paid by controller, discard by bound opponent.

name: Shade of the Devoured Emperor
phrases: At the end of an opponent's turn
choose a player and search their deck
notes: Static turnEnding trigger with eventPlayerIs opponent = any opponent's turn (a). 'Choose a player' is a faction selector over all factions, so any player including self is selectable.

name: Sharpey Pointy Lethal Army Tool
phrases: all characters your opponents control lose 1 life
destroy all characters your opponents control
notes: Both forEach selectors controller:opponent would hit only the bound opponent inside a block; both effects must cover every opponent (forEachPlayer over opponents, or all-opponents selector scope).

name: Shriever General
phrases: if an opponent's faction lost influence this turn
inflict 2 damage to that faction and pick a character that opponent controls
notes: Condition lostInfluenceThisTurn player:opponent is existential, and the later 'that faction'/'that opponent' must refer to an opponent who satisfied it. Needs the condition to quantify over opponents and bind the qualifying one as the block's opponent for the damage and character pick.

name: Silencer
phrases: If a character enters play under your opponent's control
notes: Static trigger on eventCardControlledBy opponent = any opponent.

name: Sockem Bot
phrases: Any player may use this ability
notes: usableBy anyPlayer = every seat. No opponent reference; ensure engine treats anyPlayer as all living players in N-player.

name: Stuttershy
phrases: each opponent's faction gains 1 influence
for each influence gained this way
notes: Wrap modifyInfluence (player opponent, +1) in forEachPlayer over every opponent. The optional Micromajig token is 'for each influence gained' = number of opponents (currently creates exactly 1): token count must become the total influence gained (N-1), still one 'may' decision.

name: Swindle
phrases: Your opponents cannot respond to this card
Each opponent must attach a resource to their faction
notes: noResponse already covers all other players. The attach effect (chooser/selector owner:opponent, attachTo factionOf opponent) addresses one opponent; wrap in forEachPlayer over every opponent. Draw/discard stay outside the fan-out.

name: Tedious TriAdic Truculence
phrases: Any opponent may pay 3
notes: 'Any opponent' is encoded as mayPay player:opponent (one bound opponent). Should be any-of-the-opponents may pay (anyPlayerMayPay restricted to opponents, first payer wins), not just the bound one. The picks and X effects need no change.

name: Tempered Rage
phrases: Each faction loses X influence
notes: Already forEachPlayer; modifyInfluence player:controller rebinds to the iterated player. Verify the rebinding.

name: Temple of Rantzigore
phrases: Characters your opponents control lose 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed
notes: Static area modifiers selector controller:opponent = every opponent's characters.

name: Thabbashite Penumbra
phrases: Pick an opponent
different staple resources that player controls
notes: X counts the bound opponent's staples; binding must occur before cost payment.

name: Thabbashite Weapons Expert
phrases: inflict X damage to each opponent's faction
notes: The forEach selector faction controller:opponent in a resolving block resolves to the bound opponent only; must damage every opponent's faction (forEachPlayer over opponents or all-opponents selector scope).

name: The Lugubrian Council of Quotidian Affairs
phrases: Pick an opponent's character with strength X or less
That character's controller may detach up to X resources from their faction
notes: PASS: one bound opponent whose character is picked; detach chooser/selector 'opponent' resolves to the same bound opponent (the picked character's controller in the normal case). Other abilities reference no player.

name: The Ministry of Other Smaller Smaller Ministries
phrases: Each opponent must pay 2 to form an attacking party
notes: Static attackTax player:opponent applies to every opponent.

name: Totally Random Kid
phrases: that opponent's deck
notes: Mill targets ownerOf(eventCard), i.e. the damaged faction's owner, which is exactly the referenced opponent; no binding needed.

name: Trickster's Globe
phrases: an opponent's faction
When a player has no cards in their deck, they lose the game
notes: millInsteadOfFactionDamage must apply to damage to any other player's faction. emptyDeckLoses with 3+ players should mean that player is eliminated (D3) and the game continues, not that the game ends.

name: Twisted Marionette
phrases: that faction's controller puts a character they control into its owner's hand
notes: The damaged faction's controller may be any opponent, but the selector is controller:opponent (the bound opponent) while the chooser is ownerOf(eventCard). Selector must be characters controlled by controllerOf(eventCard), chosen by that player.

name: Uhluhtc Unleashed
phrases: pick an opponent and then choose one of the following
That player must destroy a character they control
notes: One bound opponent chosen before the option; both options resolve against it.

name: Undesirable Intrusion
phrases: Your opponents cannot respond to this card
notes: noResponse already covers all other players; micromajig goes to controllerOf(responded source).

name: Undevoted Gargantuan
phrases: each opponent may detach up to 3 resources from their faction
notes: Wrap the chooserSelectsTarget (chooser/selector opponent) in forEachPlayer over every opponent; each opponent decides separately.

name: Violating Ritual
phrases: Pick an opponent
That opponent discards 2 cards
notes: One bound opponent for the whole block; discard chooser/selector 'opponent' matches.

name: Voidal Bask
phrases: look at an opponent's hand
That player discards that card
notes: One bound opponent chosen at the leaves-play trigger.

name: Voidal Trinket
phrases: Pick an opponent
That opponent may detach up to X resources from their faction
notes: One bound opponent. The detach is an otherPlayerChooses cost, so the opponent must be bound before costs are paid (at activation).

name: Wasted Wickedness
phrases: Pick a player
that player
notes: 'Pick a player' encoded as two modes (bound opponent / yourself); with 3+ players the bound-opponent mode covers choosing any other player and is prompted only when >1 candidate. Opponent must be bound before costs (X is evaluated in the cost).

name: Words of Glory
phrases: the total strength of all characters your opponents control
notes: sumStat selector controller:opponent inside a block would sum only the bound opponent's characters; X must sum over every opponent (e.g. accumulate across forEachPlayer over opponents, or an all-opponents selector scope). Damage to all characters unchanged.

name: Yenassa Shipping, LLP
phrases: for each item your opponents control
notes: Static count of controller:opponent items = all opponents. The granted upkeep text uses eventPlayerIs controller (each item's own controller), unaffected.

name: Zenobian Mechanics Explained
phrases: Choose a character an opponent controls
that player discards a card
notes: One bound opponent's character; discard goes to ownerOf(selected character), same player in the normal case.
